ranking.rationale: Exact fit: a compact support-free one-piece toy with one clear wobble/rock interaction driven by geometry and gravity.
Strong kinetic instincts, but his mechanism-led machines usually benefit from assemblies and repeated cycles beyond this monolithic rocker.
Excellent at one legible transformation, though this Wish asks for rocking rather than deployment or blossoming.
Continuous paths and captive motion echo the tail track, but topology is not the central play principle here.
Could amplify the moon silhouette, but the requested spectacle is gravity rocking rather than projected shadow play.
The crescent window suits silhouette craft, but the design has no layered-light or aperture transformation.
Compact support-free craft is relevant, while the Wish explicitly excludes the multi-part tactile transformation she favors.
Strong cinematic figurative silhouette, but there is no personal reference and the mechanism must remain the primary identity.
Could make balance physically legible, but the Wish prioritizes magical spectacle rather than a science teaching object.
Tail curvature and negative space have pattern value, but modular flat arrangements conflict with the one-piece rocker.
